cv.name: Darnell Coleman
cv.headline: Controller, CPA | Month-end close, FP&A and BI dashboards
cv.summary: CPA with seven years in accounting and finance, split between controllership and analytics. I run the close for a manufacturing company and also build the SQL and Tableau reporting the business uses, so I can work as a controller or as a BI analyst.

experience.title: Controller
bullets: Own the monthly close, balance sheet reconciliations and audit preparation for a $95M manufacturer
Shortened close from 10 to 6 business days by redesigning the checklist and automating accruals
Built standard cost and margin dashboards in Tableau from NetSuite and plant data

experience.title: Financial Analyst, Business Intelligence
bullets: Wrote SQL models for clinic productivity and payer mix reporting
Supported annual budgeting for 30 outpatient clinics

experience.title: Staff Accountant
bullets: AP/AR, fixed assets and bank reconciliations
